C-DOCUMENT-RUNTIME-RELIABILITY-235-V3.Summary: Complete document-runtime reliability with Unicode-safe uploads, actionable Docomator diagnostics and strict recoverable OCR bundle activation.
C-DOCUMENT-RUNTIME-RELIABILITY-235-V3.Problem: The earlier implementation branch proved the upload and integration repairs but its approved plan coupled strict OCR activation to a monolithic installer rewrite. The production requirement is better expressed as a small strict orchestration wrapper around the existing readable application installer.

Goals.Goal: Preserve Unicode document names and evidence while using bounded ASCII idempotency headers.
Return only classified safe Docomator connection diagnostics and retain the entered connection context.
Cache the exact verified target package payload before package mutation and reuse it for deterministic offline repair.
Refuse full-bundle activation before application staging unless Poppler, Tesseract rus/eng, LibreOffice and a real control OCR are ready.
Keep the existing application installer readable and independently testable behind a small strict wrapper.

Constraints.Constraint: No SQLite schema, migration, release version, mandatory network service, Docker or LLM dependency changes.
Existing document bytes, SHA-256, Unicode source names, document_version and evidence remain immutable.
Target package operations remain additive-only: no upgrade, downgrade, removal, package=version or apt --fix-broken.
This branch starts from exact current main and contains one active approved change only.
Errors and transport normalization use no decorative motion; access codes and security-sensitive values remain never-learn.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Change the visual architecture of the organization screen.
Make Оформлятор, OCR or LLM mandatory for the core calendar and task data model.
Publish a new release tag in this change.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Russian, mixed, emoji and long filenames reach the upload API on desktop and mobile; repeat requests remain idempotent and source identity is unchanged.
DNS, connection refused, timeout, TLS, wrong service, not ready and access denied are distinguishable without stack traces, secrets or arbitrary remote details.
The package payload is profile-bound, checksum-verified, atomically cached and safe to reuse after interruption.
A full bundle exits before application staging when package preparation, full preflight or control OCR fails; the previous release and data remain active.
doctor --repair discovers the retained payload, installs only missing capabilities and finishes with a strict self-test.
Focused unit/integration/browser tests, full project CI, release/offline/systemd gates and GRACE final pass on one exact head before squash merge.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: node --test tests/http-headers.test.mjs tests/http-utils.test.mjs tests/docomator-integration.test.mjs tests/offline-package-policy.test.mjs tests/deploy-install-contract.test.mjs tests/deployment-flow.test.mjs
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The exact branch head proves upload, classified diagnostics, immutable package cache, strict pre-staging OCR acceptance and offline repair without widening runtime dependencies.

Assumptions.Assumption: The current main application installer remains the verified application/migration/service transaction engine.
Full bundles contain application/deploy plus managed Node and Python runtimes before the root wrapper executes.
Debian/Astra target-specific package sets are built on compatible reference systems.
